nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: The graphify-out/ directory contains a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships. It is the primary navigation tool for the codebase before raw browsing.

nodes.label: Graphify Query/Path/Explain CLI Tools
nodes.rationale: Three CLI commands (query, path, explain) return scoped subgraphs and are preferred over raw grep or GRAPH_REPORT.md for codebase navigation questions.

nodes.label: ProcureIQ Project
nodes.rationale: ProcureIQ was chosen over Track 1 (Physical AI) and Track 2 (Supply Chain) because it is deeply document-centric with cross-document reasoning, which plays to RAG+LLM strengths. Named as 'an AI procurement analyst that works 24/7 — catches problems before they cost you.'

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration (LangGraph)
nodes.rationale: LangGraph chosen over a simpler agent loop because procurement requires stateful cross-document reasoning across five specialized agents with conditional routing through a Supervisor.

nodes.label: Report Agent (LLM-as-Judge)
nodes.rationale: Report agent implements LLM-as-judge pattern: evaluates severity of findings, checks citation grounding, and only passes high-confidence outputs to the dashboard — explicitly named to signal production AI thinking to judges.

nodes.label: Construction-Domain Hybrid RAG
nodes.rationale: Hybrid (dense semantic + BM25 keyword) retrieval chosen because construction procurement requires exact-match retrieval for PO numbers, vendor codes, SKUs — pure semantic search misses these. Four Pinecone namespaces (contracts, POs, invoices, vendors) for scoped access.

nodes.label: Guardrails / Safety Layer
nodes.rationale: Guardrails added as input/output safety checks: input covers NSFW image detection, PII detection, prompt injection; output covers hallucination grounding check and confidence thresholds. Most hackathon teams skip this — it is a differentiation signal.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
nodes.rationale: RBAC using JWT tokens with three roles (Strategist, Auditor, Gatekeeper) maps directly to procurement workflow stakeholders. Pinecone query-level scoping restricts what data each role can retrieve — signals production-ready thinking to judges.

nodes.label: Vendor Risk Score Formula
nodes.rationale: Weighted formula: 0.35*delivery_delay_rate + 0.30*invoice_anomaly_rate + 0.20*contract_compliance_score + 0.15*external_reputation_score minus data_sparsity_penalty. Explicit formula shown to judges signals rigorous thinking over vague scoring.
